_meta.purpose: Courier / fetch errands for the v26 narration overhaul. An NPC in `fromCity` asks the player to deliver an item to `toCity` (kind:'deliver') or recover a dropped item on `route` and return it at `toCity` (kind:'recover'). Mirrored by DEFAULT_STORY_ERRANDS in battle.html (offline fallback). Reward sizes are MAINTAINER-OWNED balance numbers — tune freely. reward can be { gold }, { ultra } (Ultra Balls), or { item:{id,count} }.

offerLines: The foreman wipes his hands on his trousers before he gives you the ledger.
Are you going through the pass? The Move Tutor in the next town needs this today. I can pay you 1,200G when you get it there.
deliverLines: The tutor runs a finger down the page. ‘He put the night shift back on. Good. I’ll send the lessons over before the bell.’
They check the envelope the foreman left for you. ‘That should be 1,200. Count it if you like.’
errands.townLine: The tutor stayed late after you brought that ledger. The quarry crew’s collecting their lessons before the next shift.

offerLines: A student catches up to you at the gate and nearly drops a stack of paper.
My sister has an exam tomorrow. She’s staying by the lake, and I left her notes in my bag. Would you take them to her? I can pay.
deliverLines: His sister pushes a half-finished practice paper out of the way. ‘He found the whole chapter. I thought I’d have to sit it without a map.’
She pulls a chair up to the lamp. ‘He said you’d be paid. Here, before I go back to this.’
errands.townLine: The student by the lake has been at that table since you brought the notes. She finally got the route map right.

offerLines: The Safari warden pats the empty loop on her belt.
Have you seen a canvas pouch? I had it at the boardwalk. If you find it, bring it to the ranger station. There’s an Ultra Ball in it you can keep.
recoverLines: A strap has caught on a post beneath the boardwalk. The name sewn into the muddy pouch is the warden’s.
deliverLines: The warden checks for the spare gate key first. ‘There it is. I’ve had two rangers waiting for me to open that gate.’
She wipes the mud off the Ultra Ball and hands it back to you. ‘I did say you could keep this.’
errands.townLine: The warden found the gate key in that pouch you brought. The rangers finished their count before dark.
